note: Summaries (tools/qa/real-perf-summary.mjs) of tools/qa/real-perf.mjs runs: production QA build, 1470x956 CSS at deviceScaleFactor 2, headless Chrome with ANGLE Metal on a MacBook Air M2 (8 GB), live practice matches with bots, five minutes per run unless the match reached its results first. fps counts frames drawn; frame times are display intervals; load is the mean 1-minute load average; thermal counts seconds at each pressure level (0 nominal, 1 moderate, 2 heavy).

sets.final: The final build (dynamic resolution v7) and the before runs that pair with it, 12:37 to 14:26.
sets.rerun: The Low after runs repeated on the final build at 14:52 and 14:57 with the load back to 5; the first Low pair in final ran under a load of 8 and then 12 to 30 from another process. The report table uses these.
sets.sustained-calm: Calmer machine, 11:55 to 12:25: before runs used in the final table; the after runs here are the v2 controller (superseded).
sets.sustained: Interleaved before and after batch, 10:44 to 11:28 (after the Claude app pane stopped contending for the GPU), after build with the v2 controller (superseded).
